subject: Post-demo: GDPR role alignment, DPA request & security docs kickoff
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.co>, MedSys Security <security@medsys.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: GDPR role alignment, DPA request & security docs kickoff

Hi Elena / MedSys team,

Thanks for taking the demo today — good to see the product fit into your ingestion and de-identification flows. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum on contracting and security: 

Key open items we discussed:
- SOC 2: whether you require Redwood to have an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report (and any specific trust services criteria).
- GDPR roles: clarification of controller vs processor responsibilities for the integration and whether you need an SCC module that reflects controller-to-processor binding clauses.
- DPA: formal DPA execution (your preference on edits) and any specific retention or deletion clauses tied to patient data HIPAA overlap.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): you mentioned your security team will send one — happy to complete it and provide evidence.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Please confirm the preferred SCC module (controller-to-processor or controller-to-controller mapping) or say if you want Redwood to propose wording.
2) Share the VSQ when ready — we’ll start filling it and return within 3 business days.
3) If you want, I’ve attached our standard DPA template for your legal to review; Marissa from Legal Ops will be the point for edits.
4) Ben will pull together SOC 2 artifacts (or provide status if in-progress).

If that looks good I’ll follow up here with a delivery plan and target dates. Happy to schedule a short legal-to-legal sync if needed — suggest next Tue if that works for you.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.2.docx (DPA template)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.co>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, MedSys Security <security@medsys.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: GDPR role alignment, DPA request & security docs kickoff

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. 

A few quick answers from our side: 
- SOC 2: We currently maintain SOC 2 Type II; latest report completed 2025-11. Our security team may still ask for specific controls mapping (esp. change management + encryption in transit at rest).
- GDPR roles: MedSys intends to act as data controller for patient records. For the integration we expect Redwood to be a processor; we will need a processor-focused SCC module.
- DPA: please send your DPA draft (we saw the attachment) — our counsel will review but may request a few redlines around subprocessors and audit rights.
- VSQ: attaching the vendor questionnaire we use internally. We’d prefer Redwood to complete it and return; security will triage evidence requests after review.

We can do a short legal/infosec sync on Tue 2026-09-01 10:00am PT if that works for Redwood.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Integrations | MedSys
elena.ruiz@medsys.co

Attachment: MedSys_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: GDPR role alignment, DPA request & security docs kickoff

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Elena’s reply and the VSQ. Quick internal plan proposal: 

Option A (recommended): Redwood signs a processor DPA + Processor SCC module. We accept controller instructions, include standard subprocessors clause, and offer audit rights via SOC 2 plus annual attestation.
Option B: If MedSys insists on a controller-to-controller-like clause for any reason, legal will need to review for feasibility — this typically adds negotiation time.

Action items (owners):
- Ben: pull SOC 2 Type II report, control mappings (change mgmt, encryption), and a short evidence pack. Target: 48 hours.
- Marissa: review the attached Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.2 and prepare a redline we can share with MedSys counsel.
- Sergio: draft a filled VSQ response with Ben’s artifacts attached.

I’ll schedule the Tue 9/1 10am PT call provisionally. If you see any blockers please flag.

Sergio

Elena — thanks, that timeline works. Quick status update from Redwood: 
- We’ll complete the MedSys VSQ and return the completed PDF by 2026-09-02 COB.
- Ben will upload the SOC 2 report and a short controls mapping by 2026-08-31 EOD (link will be shared).
- Marissa will prepare a DPA redline and we’ll send that to your counsel before the Tue 9/1 sync.

Next steps for Tuesday’s legal/infosec sync:
- Confirm the processor SCC module text and subprocessors clause.
- Walk through evidence items requested in the VSQ (Elena, pls highlight any MUST-HAVE items).
- Agree on timeline for DPA signature (target: within 2 weeks of redline agreement).

If anyone prefers an earlier thread-only review (no call) I can post the redline and the completed VSQ to the shared drive and loop counsel asynchronously.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want to keep this on a tight timeline so integration planning can start next month.

Best,
